subject: CAIQ: control anchoring and sample curation for ZenithPay evaluation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenithpay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@zenithpay.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control anchoring & sample curation for ZenithPay evaluation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, our security team needs a CAIQ-style mapping and a small sample package so our auditors can validate a handful of controls before the procurement window closes. We're prioritizing controls around tenant isolation, KMS/key rotation, runtime telemetry (inference logs), and KV cache locality for inference caching.

Requested deliverables:
- CAIQ mapping (control IDs mapped to Redwood assertions + evidence pointers)
- One sample of each evidence type (screenshots or redacted logs) with instructions for how to reproduce or extract the artifact
- A short mutual action plan (timeline + owner) so our security team can track signoffs

Constraints: our auditors need pseudonymized traces (no customer PII), time window Aug 15-22 preferred. We also need an SLA note about retention for telemetry artifacts (30/90/365 days options).

Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD next Tue (Aug 25)? PO is being issued in parallel (PO# 8421).

Attachment: ZenithPay-CAIQ-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (our completed workbook — some fields intentionally blank)

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Security Program Manager
ZenithPay

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenithpay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ control anchoring & sample curation for ZenithPay evaluation

Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the workbook. Appreciate the PO update. High-level plan below; details and owners are included in the attachments.

Plan (summary):
1) CAIQ anchor map: we will produce a control-level mapping that ties each CAIQ question to a Redwood assertion and a short evidence path (live artifact names and Drive links). Deliverable: RI-CAIQ-AnchorMap-v1.xlsx (attached)
2) Evidence samples: collect 4 sample artifacts with redaction instructions (KMS rotation screenshot, KMS policy export, runtime telemetry snippet + parsing notes, KV cache locality trace). We will pseudonymize all logs before sharing.
3) Mutual action plan: simple milestones (evidence collection, internal review, secure upload to your intake portal) with owners (Kimberly owns evidence collation; Marissa will coordinate the upload and DocuSign attestation). Deliverable: mutual_action_plan.md (attached)
4) Retention/SLAs: we'll include a short appendix showing standard telemetry retention options (30/90/365) and your choices in the workbook.

Timeline: we can deliver the anchor map and initial samples by Tue Aug 25 EOD. Full evidence package (if auditors need more sampling) by Sep 3.

Next steps for you: confirm the Aug 15-22 sampling window and whether you need redaction done by Redwood or if you will perform redaction on your side.

Attachments: RI-CAIQ-AnchorMap-v1.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.md

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0187

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenithpay.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CAIQ evidence collection plan for ZenithPay (owners + artifacts)

Team — looping in specifics so we can hit the Aug 25 deliverable. I reviewed RI-CAIQ-AnchorMap-v1 and added inline notes (in the workbook). Below are concrete artifacts I will collect and where to pull them from.

Artifacts and extraction notes:
- KMS rotation proof: screenshot of key rotation events from our KMS console + export of key policy (redact key IDs). Preferred sample time: Aug 17 03:00-04:00 UTC (rotation job run). File: screenshot_kms_rotation.png (we'll attach a sanitized export).
- KMS policy export: iam_policy_rotation.json (policy with comments explaining rotation cadence).
- Audit logs: inference request logs (pseudonymized request IDs) for Aug 16-18; include example trace showing tenant_id and model variant resolution. We'll redact user text. File: runtime_telemetry_snippet.log (redacted).
- KV cache locality: sampling trace showing cache hit/miss counters and host affinity for a 2-hour window. We'll produce an aggregated CSV (kv_locality_sample.csv) that shows node affinity percentages rather than raw payloads.
- Tenant isolation proof: orchestration config snapshot (tenant-routing.yaml) + a short narrated walkthrough video (2-3 min).

Owners and deadlines:
- Kimberly: collect KMS and runtime telemetry artifacts by Aug 24 EOD
- Marissa: prepare secure upload lane and DocuSign attestation; coordinate with Liam's intake portal
- Karthik: liaison to ZenithPay for any scope clarifications

Upload mechanism: Marissa please create a secure intake folder (encrypted Drive share) and set link expiration to 30 days. Use evidence_intake_template.csv (attached) to ensure metadata for each artifact (control mapped, owner, time window, redaction notes).

Attachments: evidence_intake_template.csv

Questions for Liam (cc'd):
1) Can you confirm whether your auditors accept aggregated CSVs for KV cache traces (no raw request payloads)?
2) Should we perform pseudonymization (recommended) or will ZenithPay perform in-house?

Thanks — I'll start harvesting artifacts tomorrow.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenithpay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@zenithpay.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ control anchoring & sample curation for ZenithPay evaluation

Karthik / Kimberly / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the plan. A few clarifications so we get exactly what the auditors need: 

- Aggregated CSV for KV cache locality is acceptable as long as it shows node_id, hit_count, miss_count, and timestamp bucket (no request payloads).
- For runtime telemetry: pseudonymization by Redwood is preferred (if you can remove or hash any user-generated text). Please include the pseudonymization steps in the metadata field of the intake template.
- For KMS artifacts: please ensure the rotation screenshot is accompanied by the rotation job log lines (timestamps + job id) — redacted job id is fine.

We will confirm the PO and issue it this week (PO# 8421). Also: our auditors requested a one-paragraph statement that Redwood's telemetry retention default is 90 days and options exist for 30/365 with add-on pricing — that can be part of your retention appendix.

If you can upload the anchor map and the four sample artifacts to the secure intake link by EOD Tue (Aug 25), we can slot the audit review for Aug 27. Appreciated.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Security Program Manager
ZenithPay
security@zenithpay.com
